title: Companion Bookings Cancelled by Crestline and Refunds on Cancellation — Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes
content:
A companion booking on Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes whose flight Crestline cancelled has its trip reinstated on its own terms, and every cancellation brings a refund of the companion's charges.

## When Crestline cancels the companion's flight

When Crestline cancels the companion's flight and the holder does not accept rebooking, the trip is reinstated on the ground of a Crestline cancellation, without fee, and if the book-by date has passed or falls within the product's irregular-operations extension (30 calendar days on every product) it is moved to the reinstatement date plus those 30 calendar days.

| Hypothetical case (reinstatement on 10 March, extension of 30 calendar days) | Book-by date after reinstatement |
|---|---|
| Book-by date already passed, on 1 March | 9 April |
| Book-by date 20 March, within the 30 days | 9 April |
| Book-by date 30 September, far outside the 30 days | unchanged, 30 September |

## Refunds on every cancellation

On every cancellation the companion fare and taxes are refunded in the product's refund form, one refund entry per charge entry.

The clause "phone booking fees are not refunded" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the phone booking fee refund.

superseded_clauses: phone booking fees are not refunded
